search.website_text:
Dalamud Plugin for modular custom status management. ![Loci](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CordeliaMist/Loci/main/Assets/icon_square.png)

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CordeliaMist/Loci/main/repo.json
```
Apply custom Status effects to Players and companions alike. Apply in bulk with presets, and use automation with events!

- Extensive API
- Ephemeral hosting
- Status Locking
- Preset application
- Target application
- Companion/Pet application
- Event-Monitored status and preset automation

This is a [Dalamud](https://goatcorp.github.io/faq/dalamud_troubleshooting.html) plugin. You will need Dalamud and [XIVLauncher](https://goatcorp.github.io/) installed to use it.

## Contributions
Plugin Icon designed by Yuzuki!
